input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，the time word 古代 already names a period, so adding 的时候 is redundant.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟孩子搬家：带着孩子搬家，跟 means “together with,” while a mother moving her child to a new home is expressed with 带着.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个城市：另一个城市，另一个 is the standard expression for “another” one; 别的 is used to distinguish other things from the one being discussed.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟母：一个叫孟子的小男孩和他的妈妈，first mention should introduce the character with both a name and who he is.
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 住了在：住在，a continuing living state takes the zero particle rather than 了, and 了 cannot be placed before the locative complement.
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孩子：他，use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence when the referent was named in the previous sentence and no other person competes with it.
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每天在墓地祭拜了：每天在墓地祭拜，daily routines take the zero particle rather than completed-action 了.
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 在那个城市：在他们住的城市里，this is the first mention of the city, so use a full noun phrase rather than the demonstrative phrase 那个城市.
9. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得自己没有钱，when the person affected is the same as the subject, use 自己 to show that relationship clearly instead of repeating the name.
10. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 搬了到：搬到了，when 到 is a directional complement, completed-action 了 comes after it: 搬到了.

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly formed under the teacher's rule.
跟孩子搬家 is an acceptable way to say that the mother moved together with her child, although 带着孩子 is also possible.
别一个城市 is not the appropriate expression for another city; 另一个城市 is correct.
At the first mention, the teacher requires a brief identifying introduction for 孟子 rather than names alone.
住了在 has both an incorrectly placed 了 and an incomplete locative construction; 住在 needs a following place phrase.
孩子 is vague here, whereas 他 can clearly refer back to the recently mentioned 孟子.
每天 describes a routine, so the final perfective 了 should not be used.
The city has not previously been established, so 那个城市 does not sufficiently identify it on first mention.
Repeating 孟母 is grammatical and clear; 自己 is possible but not required here.
With the directional complement 到, 了 must follow it, but 搬到了 still needs the omitted destination to be a complete phrase.
